Proposition
1. ch5:5.8

If $M$ is an embedded Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian submanifold of $\mathbb R^n$ or $\mathbb R^{r,s}$, its tangential connection is compatible with the induced metric.

Proof

\sketch For ambient extensions $\widetilde X,\widetilde Y,\widetilde Z$ of $X,Y,Z\in \mathfrak X(M)$, ambient metric compatibility and orthogonal projection give

egin{align*} X\langle Y,Z angle & =\langle \overline abla _{\widetilde X}\widetilde Y,\widetilde Z angle +\langle \widetilde Y,\overline abla _{\widetilde X}\widetilde Z angle \ & =\langle abla _X^ op Y,Z angle +\langle Y, abla _X^ op Z angle . \end{align*}

□
